meta.title: 范文重点词
meta.desc: 大作文范文 + 小作文范文里反复出现的提分表达：点词看释义、用法和例句。

groups.name: 图表描述
groups.desc: 第一段把图说清楚、说出重点

groups.name: 论证说理
groups.desc: 第二段解释原因、讲清机制

items.use: 结论句常用；与 in the short term 相对。
items.ex: Establishing a regular habit of exercise will yield substantial benefits in the long run.
items.exCn: 养成规律锻炼的习惯，长远来看收益巨大。

items.use: 对策句：steady funding from the government（政府稳定投入）。
items.ex: Steady funding from the government is the key to spreading first-aid training.
items.exCn: 政府稳定的资金投入是普及急救培训的关键。

items.use: 对策句主干：set clear rules for ...（为…立规矩）。
items.ex: Clear rules should be set for online platforms to curb false information.
items.exCn: 应为网络平台立下明确规则，以遏制虚假信息。

items.use: 首段末或第二段开头定调，一句把态度说透。
items.ex: This is a positive trend worth welcoming.
items.exCn: 这是一个值得欢迎的积极趋势。

items.use: 第二段万能引入，不承诺条数：This phenomenon can be attributed to a combination of factors.
items.ex: This phenomenon can be attributed to a combination of factors.
items.exCn: 这一现象可归因于多种因素的共同作用。

items.use: be of great importance to sb/sth，替代 very important。
items.ex: Accessible facilities are of great importance to people with mobility difficulties.
items.exCn: 无障碍设施对行动不便者至关重要。

items.use: 并列第二条理由/对策，替代烂大街的 Secondly。
items.ex: Equally important, clear rules should be set for online platforms.
items.exCn: 同样重要的是，应为网络平台制定明确的规则。

items.use: A can be attributed to B；比 because of 更书面，注意被动语态。
items.ex: The shift can be attributed to the rapid spread of mobile payment.
items.exCn: 这一转变可归因于移动支付的迅速普及。

items.use: 第三段收束的乐观句：... will be within our reach。
items.ex: A balance between development and protection will be within our reach.
items.exCn: 发展与保护之间的平衡将指日可待。

items.use: 抽象原因：the momentum behind this change（这一变化背后的推力）。
items.ex: The momentum behind this change comes largely from government support.
items.exCn: 这一变化背后的推力主要来自政府支持。

items.use: 第二段列原因：Several factors may contribute to this pattern.
items.ex: Several factors may contribute to this pattern.
items.exCn: 若干因素可能共同造成了这一格局。

items.use: 数据/原因排序：X tops the list at X%，后接 followed by。
items.ex: Personal development prospects top the list at 65 per cent, followed by pay at 53 per cent.
items.exCn: 个人发展前景以 65% 位居榜首，其次是薪酬 53%。

items.use: 第三段提建议：We should bear in mind that + 从句。
items.ex: We should bear in mind that lifelong learning is of great importance to personal development.
items.exCn: 我们应牢记，终身学习对个人发展至关重要。

items.use: 句首 + 部分倒装：Only through ... can we ...，收束段最有力。
items.ex: Only through the joint efforts of communities and individuals can these skills become widely available.
items.exCn: 只有通过社区与个人的共同努力，这些技能才能普及。

items.use: 句首时部分倒装：By no means should we + 动词原形。
items.ex: By no means should we give up our efforts to protect the environment.
items.exCn: 我们决不应当放弃保护环境的努力。

items.cn: 清楚地显示出（图表内容）
items.use: 第一段描述图表：The chart clearly illustrates + 名词短语，比 shows 更书面。
items.ex: The bar chart clearly illustrates the steady growth of online shopping over the past decade.
items.exCn: 柱状图清楚地显示了近十年网购的稳步增长。

items.use: 把消费类图表落到「生活」层面的用词，比 daily goods 更书面。
items.ex: Smartphones have changed from a luxury into an everyday necessity.
items.exCn: 智能手机已从奢侈品变成日常必需品。

items.use: 图表主体词：rising household incomes（家庭收入提高）常作原因。
items.ex: Rising household incomes have made travel affordable for ordinary families.
items.exCn: 家庭收入的提高让普通家庭也负担得起旅行。

items.use: 饼图描述最大项：X accounts for the largest share, at X%。
items.ex: Mobile payment accounts for the largest share, at 45 per cent.
items.exCn: 移动支付占比最大，达到 45%。

items.use: 描述陡升：rise sharply / rose sharply from A to B；缓升用 rose steadily。
items.ex: The number of delivery orders rose sharply from 2 billion to 13 billion in ten years.
items.exCn: 十年间快递业务量从 20 亿件猛增到 130 亿件。

items.use: 讲占比：A accounts for X% of the total，也可换成 makes up / represents。
items.ex: Students who take part-time jobs account for 37 per cent of the total.
items.exCn: 兼职学生占总人数的 37%。

items.use: 描述最小项：X comes last, at only X%，和前两项形成对照。
items.ex: Reading for pleasure comes last, at only 8 per cent.
items.exCn: 为消遣而阅读排在最后，仅占 8%。

items.use: 点明图型：bar chart / line chart / pie chart；开头一句先交代图型最稳。
items.ex: The bar chart compares the purposes of continuing education among employees.
items.exCn: 该柱状图比较了在职人员参加继续学习的目的。

items.k: I hope this message finds you well
items.use: 书信开头第一句，最稳的问候，替代 How are you。
items.ex: I hope this message finds you well.
items.exCn: 希望你一切都好。

items.use: 建议信核心句：I suggest that you consider taking concrete steps to ...
items.ex: You may consider taking concrete steps to improve your listening.
items.exCn: 你可以考虑采取具体措施提高听力。

items.use: 催回复/催安排：reply at your earliest convenience。
items.ex: I would be grateful if you could reply at your earliest convenience.
items.exCn: 如能尽早回复，我将不胜感激。

items.use: 礼貌请求：I would appreciate it (very much) if you could + 动词原形。
items.ex: I would appreciate it if you could arrange an immediate replacement.
items.exCn: 如能安排立即更换，我将不胜感激。

items.use: 感谢信：express my profound gratitude to you for ...。
items.ex: I am writing to express my profound gratitude for your generous help.
items.exCn: 我写此信是为了对你的慷慨帮助表达深切谢意。

items.use: 建议类书信：make full use of the resources available。
items.ex: You can make full use of the library and the online courses.
items.exCn: 你可以充分利用图书馆和线上课程。

items.use: 结尾句：I look forward to your reply / to hearing from you.
items.ex: I look forward to your early reply.
items.exCn: 期待您早日回复。

items.use: 知道收信人姓名时用 Yours sincerely，不知姓名用 Yours faithfully。
items.ex: Yours sincerely, Li Ming
items.exCn: 您诚挚的，李明

items.use: 结尾提供帮助：Please let me know if you need further information.
items.ex: Please let me know if you need any further information.
items.exCn: 如需更多信息，请告诉我。

items.use: 活动/会议安排：The lecture will take place in Room 302.
items.ex: The lecture will take place in the main hall next Friday.
items.exCn: 讲座将于下周五在主楼大厅举行。

items.use: 说明原因/致歉：due to a change of plan。
items.ex: The delay was due to an unexpected change of plan.
items.exCn: 延误是由于计划意外变更造成的。
